offering_description.value: Sells cat litter to retailers and pet owners, and clay-based mineral products to processors, agricultural businesses and industrial customers. It mines and processes clay into branded and private-label litter, purification media, agricultural carriers, animal feed additives and other specialty absorbents.

primary_products.value: cat litter; oil purification adsorbents; agricultural carriers and animal feed additives; industrial spill absorbents; sports field conditioners

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery and pet retailers, oil and fuel processors, agricultural and feed manufacturers, industrial distributors, sports facility operators; B2C: Cat owners

end_markets.value: pet care; edible oil and renewable fuel processing; agriculture and animal nutrition; industrial maintenance; sports field maintenance

revenue_model.value: product sales: Branded and private-label cat litter, purification media, agricultural minerals and specialty absorbents

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes mined clay into packaged litter and specialty mineral products for retailers, processors and distributors; raw materials: Mines and processes clay for oil refiners, feed producers and agricultural formulators

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with sales in Europe, Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Cat litter, purification media, agricultural minerals, industrial absorbents and sports field conditioners made from processed clay

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Mass-market, grocery and pet specialty retailers; direct sales: Private-label retail accounts and commercial customers purchasing mineral products; distributors / dealers: Industrial supply and sports field product distributors; online: Online retailers selling packaged cat litter
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; direct sales; distributors / dealers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Clay mining and processing face mine safety and environmental rules, and feed additives face animal feed safety requirements.
